scripts.storybook: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm registry:build && node --import tsx scripts/storybook.ts stylex
scripts.storybook:upstream: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm originals:generate && node --import tsx scripts/storybook.ts upstream
scripts.build:upstream: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm originals:generate && cross-env ARIAX_IMPLEMENTATION=upstream storybook build -o dist/upstream
scripts.build:stylex: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm registry:build && cross-env ARIAX_IMPLEMENTATION=stylex storybook build -o dist/stylex && node --import tsx scripts/check-storybook-css.ts
scripts.build: pnpm registry:build && pnpm build:upstream && pnpm build:stylex
scripts.registry:build: node --import tsx scripts/generate-registry-catalog.ts && shadcn build registry.json --output registry
scripts.registry:check: node --import tsx scripts/generate-registry-catalog.ts --check && shadcn registry validate ./registry.json
scripts.test: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm originals:generate && playwright test
scripts.test:install: pnpm registry:check && node --import tsx --test scripts/install-fixtures.test.ts scripts/registry-sources.test.ts && pnpm registry:build && node --import tsx scripts/test-install.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm registry:check && pnpm test:stylex && pnpm test:upstream && pnpm upstream:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm registry:build && pnpm test && pnpm test:install && pnpm build:upstream && pnpm build:stylex
scripts.test:ci: pnpm upstream:prepare && pnpm originals:generate && cross-env ARIAX_TEST_MODE=ci playwright test tests/parity.spec.ts --grep @static-parity
